verdict.rationale: Postmark is an API-first service that runs headlessly by design. Every operation is a token-authenticated REST call: sending, templates, servers, message streams, domains and bounces. It also offers official SDKs in several languages, and a community user reports driving it with plain curl. For CI it provides a `POSTMARK_API_TEST` token for testing without sending, server sandbox mode, and fake-bounce generation. Missing for 10: no official CLI or CI-specific integration guide in evidence, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and little independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
